jobs.title: SAP FICO Consultant (BRIM, FICA, RAR)
jobs.description:
**SAP FICO Consultant (BRIM, FICA, RAR)** 




**Sunnyvale, CA – (Onsite)** 




**W2 Contract/ Fulltime (Permanent)** 




  





**Job Description:**




  





**Experience:**
 Minimum 12\+ years of Experience as a SAP FICO Consultant
 



  





**Core Skills:**



* **SAP Modules:** 
 FICO, BRIM, FICA, RAR, MM, SD, PP
* **SAP Processes \& Configuration:** 
 Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Bank Accounting (BA), Fixed Assets, Depreciation, Acquisition, Retirement, Cost Centre Accounting (CCA), Profit Centre Accounting (PCA), Product Costing, Company Codes, Controlling Areas, Profit Centres, Cost Centres, Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting
* **SAP Implementation \& Project Management:** 
 ERP solutions, Designing, Implementing, Deploying, Validating report requirements, Validating changes, Customizing, Training end\-users, Solution stability, Data evaluation, Data movement, Data exclusion, Data historicization, Gap analysis ("As\-Is" to "To\-Be"), Transition Service Agreement (TSA), Data mapping, Data separation, Data neutralization, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Pre\-cutover reconciliations, Post\-cutover reconciliations, End\-to\-end data flow
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Finance, Financial Integrity, Data Privacy Regulations



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Design, implement, and deploy SAP\-based ERP solutions for client.
* Validate report requirements, changes, and customization.
* Provide training to end\-users ensuring solution stability.
* Work closely with client Finance team to sort day\-to\-day queries.
* Evaluate existing SAP data to determine what needs to be moved, excluded, or historicized, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations.
* Work with senior leadership to design the new company code structure, chart of accounts, and financial reporting requirements.
* Identify gaps between the "As\-Is" (current) process in the parent company and the "To\-Be" process required for the separated entity.
* Assist in defining the Transition Service Agreement (TSA) to ensure a smooth, compliant handover from the seller to the buyer.
* Configure new Company Codes, Controlling Areas, Profit Centres, and Cost Centres in the new SAP instance.
* Configure Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Bank Accounting (BA) tailored to the new entity’s operations.
* Manage the separation of fixed assets, including depreciation, acquisition, and retirement data.
* Configure Cost Centre Accounting (CCA), Profit Centre Accounting (PCA), and Product Costing.
* Map financial data from the source to the target environment.
* Remove or neutralize data related to business units not involved in the carve\-out.
* Conduct System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support to ensure the accuracy of carved\-out financial data and processes.
* Perform pre\- and post\-cutover reconciliations to ensure financial integrity between the old and new systems.
* Collaborate with MM (Materials Management), SD (Sales \& Distribution), and PP (Production Planning) teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end data flow.

jobs.description:
At VertexOne, helping utilities provide the best customer service experience is what we do. VertexOne is the recognized leader in SaaS platforms for utilities across North America. Through a wide range of innovative services and solutions, VertexOne helps utilities deliver a compelling customer experience; reducing the cost to serve customers, increasing operational efficiency, improving customer satisfaction, and driving utility operations forward. It’s been in the DNA of our people since we started supporting utilities’ customer experience needs over 20 years ago. And that commitment continues to this day.
  
  

Our team members are our greatest assets, so we pride ourselves on being ‘Employee First’. As such, we listen to what our employees have to say and find ways to incorporate their ideas into the company. Whether it’s new technology, career development opportunities, or fun events, we find new ways to keep our employees engaged and incentivized to grow within the company. Our employees' well\-being—both physical and mental—is a top priority at VertexOne. That's why we foster a 100% remote and flexible environment and encourage work\-life balance.
  
  

VertexOne is proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work®. Great Place to Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors proven to deliver market\-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation. VertexOne is dedicated to prioritizing the employee experience and creating an exceptional company culture.
  
  

Position Summary
  
We are seeking an SAP Utilities Customer Service Technical Consultant II to join our growing SAP Utilities practice. In this role, you will support utility clients by designing, developing, integrating, and maintaining SAP IS\-U Customer Service solutions that drive operational efficiency and enhance the customer experience.
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong SAP IS\-U Customer Service technical expertise, hands\-on ABAP development experience, and a proven ability to support integrations, workflows, Fiori applications, and customer service business processes. This role partners with functional consultants, architects, and client stakeholders to deliver scalable, high\-quality solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
  
Expertise
  
* Design, develop, and support technical solutions within SAP IS\-U Customer Service.
* Create and maintain ABAP reports, enhancements, interfaces, workflows, forms, and custom developments.
* Develop and support integrations between SAP IS\-U, SAP CRM, SAP S/4HANA Utilities, and third\-party applications.
* Build and maintain APIs, web services, IDocs, RFCs, and middleware\-based integrations.
* Support SAP Fiori applications and user experience enhancements.
* Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
* Troubleshoot complex application issues and perform root cause analysis.
* Support data migration and conversion efforts for implementations and transformation projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality, scalable solutions.
* Create technical documentation and support knowledge transfer activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and SAP modernization programs.


Required Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6\-8 years of SAP technical consulting experience.
* 6\+ years of experience supporting SAP IS\-U Customer Service solutions.
* Strong ABAP development experience, including reports, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
* Experience with SAP CRM integrations and customer service business processes.
* Hands\-on experience with APIs, web services, IDocs, RFCs, and middleware technologies.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Utilities and modern SAP architecture.
* Experience supporting testing, deployments, and production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and client\-facing abilities.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience within electric, gas, water, or multi\-service utility organizations.
* SAP Utilities (IS\-U) implementation or Application Management Services (AMS) experience.
* Experience with SAP Fiori and user interface technologies.
* Knowledge of SAP Business Workflow and process automation.
* Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with utility customer service processes, including customer account management, move\-in/move\-out activities, service requests, and customer interactions.
* SAP certification in IS\-U, ABAP, S/4HANA, or related SAP technologies.

jobs.title: Senior SAP FICA Specialist
jobs.description:
Role Description:

The Financial Systems team provides technology expertise to the finance department and is responsible for SAP, HANA, and connected 3rd party systems at Booking.com. We want to change the way people work with SAP, by building a finance application platform that supports simplification of business processes, and empowers the finance community with better financial insights.


We run our SAP environment on HANA and in February 2016 we migrated to Simple Finance. In 2019 we started our journey to S4 HANA.  

  

**Role Description**


As a FICA Specialist You will utilize your knowledge of SAP FICO and FICA/FICAx to design solutions which meet business objectives and goals.


You will participate in the development of solution design documents, functional design documents, configurational rationale, testing and deployment.


You will partner with business owners and digital teams to identify opportunities for improvement and offer up appropriate solution designs to meet business objectives


Through your experience of FICA/FICAx, you will translate business requirements into system configuration which meet business requirements.


You will have deep experience with the integration of FICA/FICAx to SAP FICO, Account Determination and Revenue Recognition.


This role involves extensive daily interaction with functional specialists, developers in all finance and IT departments in Booking.com. It is essential that you have a strong understanding of finance processes and integration with legacy systems and you have strong verbal/written communication and presentation skills in English.


Due to the rapid and continuous growth of the organization, the tasks and duties of this role may evolve over time. You will be keen to develop and grow within the role and to take on additional challenges and responsibilities as they occur.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Full ownership of projects and quality of changes, from planning, communication, coordination, compliance aspects, customization and go\-live hypercare;
* Analytical thinking;
* Providing scalable and innovative solutions;
* Ability to take fast decisions in a very dynamic environment, with some level of uncertainty;
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities (processes, people) to improve project delivery and/or development methodologies;
* Training of key users and key user support.Analyzing issues and changes;

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience with SAP FICA implementation or support, including analysing business requirements and translating them into SAP FICA technical and functional solutions
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as FI, CRM or Billing—depending on the industry—and manage integrations with external systems like payment gateways, banks, or third\-party collection tools.
* Good knowledge of Master Data, Transactional data, Invoicing \- B2B/B2C, Sub\-ledger Accounting, Dunning, Clearing, Payment Processing, Account determination, Close, FI Integration and Correspondence framework.
* Good understanding of end to end O2C process and BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management).
* Ability to have a good grasp of the details and manage multiple priorities in a quick turnaround environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Organized, flexible, proactive and result oriented.
* ABAP code debugging capability is a good to have (read, interpret, design program logic)
* Experience on integration of digital platforms/legacy applications with SAP

**Where You’ll Be**

* This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Project Manager / Support Lead to manage our production support, continuous enhancement, and operational governance across the SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) landscape. This role combines hands\-on functional understanding of core BRIM pillars with project management discipline. You will lead a blended onshore/offshore team, enforce ITIL\-based SLA/KPI targets, drive critical incident resolution, and govern small\-to\-medium business enhancements from scoping to hypercare.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 1\. Support Operations \& SLA Governance Lead day\-to\-day operations for Level 2 and Level 3 production support across the entire SAP BRIM suite. Own and report operational KPIs: mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), SLA compliance (\>98%), ticket backlog trends, and first\-time\-fix rates. Serve as the primary escalation point for Priority 1/2 billing, mediation, rating, and invoicing incidents; lead root cause analyses (RCA) and post\-mortem discussions. Manage high\-volume recurring operations: month\-end billing cycles, automated rating batches, bill\-run failures, out\-of\-sequence consumption data, and financial posting reconciliations. 2\. Project Management \& Continuous Improvement Manage minor release cadences, change requests (CRs), and platform enhancements using hybrid Agile/Scrum or Waterfall frameworks. Own project schedules, resource allocations, sprint backlogs, risk/issues/assumptions/dependencies (RAID) logs, and release readiness checklists. Coordinate end\-to\-end delivery: requirement discovery, solution design review, build, system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, cutover, and post\-deployment stabilization. Interface directly with business finance, IT steering committees, external System Integrators (SIs), and vendor partners.
 



 3\. Functional Oversight \& Solution Integrity Provide functional governance across core modules: SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management): Subscription lifecycle, master agreements, product catalog, provider contracts. SAP CC (Convergent Charging): Rating and charging logic, charge plans, allowance logic, subscriber mapping. SAP CI (Convergent Invoicing): Billable items (BITs), consumption items (CITs), bill runs, aggregation, invoicing rules. SAP RAR: Revenue postings, reconciliation \& rev\-rec. Coordinate integration integrity with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP CPQ, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), external CRM, and data mediation layers. Required
 



**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Total Experience: 8\+ years of IT delivery/support experience, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to SAP BRIM (formerly Hybris Billing) and 3\+ years running project management or application maintenance services (AMS). Core Technical Expertise: Functional or technical depth in at least two of the four BRIM components (SOM, CC, CI, RAR) alongside familiarity with the overall end\-to\-end data pipeline. Support Frameworks: Proven experience running structured ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management) using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or SAP Solution Manager. Project Delivery: Demonstrated success managing cross\-functional technical teams (developers, functional consultants, BASIS, middleware teams) across distributed time zones. Integration Acumen: Familiarity with modern SAP interface technologies (OData, REST APIs, IDocs, SAP CPI) and reconciliation between rated events and general ledger entries.

 **Job Description Summary**


AES is seeking a FICA Team Leader, within the Billing and Revenue Support department. In this role, the incumbent will provide day\-to\-day operational leadership, coaching, and subject\-matter expertise for payment processing, credit management, and fraud prevention within Billing and Revenue Support for an electric utility company in a union setting. This role coordinates workload and staffing, monitors productivity, quality, and leads to resolution of complex or escalated customer and account payment and fraud issues. The Team Leader partners with internal teams and third\-party vendors to ensure accurate and timely payment posting, strengthen credit and fraud controls, meet audit and risk\-management requirements, and advance continuous improvement while protecting company revenue and supporting customer operations.

* **Job Description**


Under general or limited supervision, the FICA Team Leader, Billing and Revenue Support is responsible and accountable for:

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the FICA team’s daily operations, including workload allocation, staffing support, scheduling, and performance monitoring.
* Coach, train, and guide team members on FICA policies, procedures, systems, and service expectations.
* Monitor productivity, quality, and service\-level results; address performance gaps and recognize opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness.
* Resolve complex and escalated customer or account issues in partnership with internal departments and external service providers.
* Ensure FICA activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, internal controls, audit standards, and risk\-management practices.
* Conduct quality reviews, identify root causes, and lead the implementation of process and procedure improvements.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, performance metrics, dashboards, and management updates.
* Monitor payment\-posting projects and open items with third\-party vendors, including KUBRA, Firstech, and RPS.
* Perform daily cash, payment, and batch\-file inspections to confirm accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Monitor weather conditions and update SAP as required to support account disconnection activities.
* Prepare and submit quarterly tax\-exempt reports to applicable state agencies.
* Conduct weekly reviews of SAP IS\-U batch and payment lots to verify that payments are posted accurately to customer accounts.
* Verify that transmittals are processed and posted accurately and on schedule.
* Oversee credit\-management activities, including customer credit risk, deposits, payment arrangements, account restrictions, write\-off considerations, and policy exceptions.
* Monitor payment and account activity for potential fraud, suspicious transactions, identity concerns, or misuse; ensure appropriate documentation, account safeguards, and timely escalation.
* Analyze credit and fraud trends, support investigations and recovery efforts, maintain effective controls, and recommend improvements that reduce financial loss and protect customer information.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer\-focused service.

 **Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least two years of leadership or supervisory experience are required.
* Working knowledge of billing, payment processing, collections, credit management, and applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications; experience with SAP ISU or comparable customer information and payment\-processing systems is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex issues, make sound business decisions, and manage competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal, coaching, and training skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and work independently with limited supervision.
* Experience in an inbound contact center and with related technologies is preferred.
* Experience in a regulated utility or another regulated work environment is preferred.
* Supervisory experience in a union environment is preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs.
